items.title: Victor Rendon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: We’re still friends but we parted our ways.

ctx.x: Yeah, well I’m still a bandleader. We’re playing today as a matter of fact. But you had Rodriguez/Rendón Latin Jazz Orchestra.

That was my first band in New York City. I think we formed it in 1990. We formed the band because we were playing at this other — and I won’t say the name because I won’t insult — we were playing with this older gentleman. And he had this concept of having a small big band. But he was so disorganized, and the music wasn’t quite there, and then you have 15 people and he would go around and let everybody take a solo, which can be a real drag after 40 minutes or so. Then we said, me and Arman said we can do better…
